**STEP 1 – Scene:** A simple breakfast: an Asian (nashi) pear and two slices of thick white toast, one spread with red jam.

**STEP 2 – Vessel:** A white rimmed dinner plate, about 26 cm across. Its area is about 530 cm².

**STEP 3 – Items:**
- Whole Asian pear
- Two slices of thick toasted white bread
- Strawberry-type jam on one slice

**STEP 4 – Area:**

| Item | Share of plate | Area |
|---|---|---|
| Pear | ~15% | ~80 cm² |
| Toast, plain slice | ~25% | ~130 cm² |
| Toast, jam slice | ~25% | ~130 cm² |
| Jam (on top of toast) | ~13% | ~70 cm² |

Total food footprint is about 65% of the plate. The jam sits on the toast, so it doesn't add to the footprint.

**STEP 5 – Volume:**
- **Pear:** It is about 11 cm wide relative to the plate. Treating it as a slightly flattened sphere gives about 445 ml.
- **Toast:** Each slice is about 130 cm² × 1.8 cm = 234 ml, so about 468 ml for both.
- **Jam:** About 70 cm² × 0.2 cm = 14 ml.

**STEP 6 – Grams:**
- **Pear:** 445 ml × ~0.85 = about 380 g.
- **Toast:** The listed slice density (0.9–1.0 g/ml) applies to compact slices. This thick, airy bread is closer to a loaf, so I used ~0.24. That gives 468 ml × 0.24 = about 110 g, or 55 g per slice.
- **Jam:** 14 ml × 1.1 = about 15 g.

**STEP 7 – Energy:**

| Item | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---|---|---|
| Asian pear | 380 g | 42 | ~160 kcal |
| White toast | 110 g | 290 | ~319 kcal |
| Jam | 15 g | 250 | ~38 kcal |

**STEP 8 – Sanity check:** The total is about 505 g and 517 kcal. A large Asian pear, two thick toast slices and a thin layer of jam make this plausible.
